# Tabitha Pratt

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c5 P11](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** General servant at Grey Shutters and Hollowmere  <sub>[v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089), [v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Tabitha is an aged unmarried woman who possesses a stern, austere, and gray appearance. She is known for having a scolding, sharp tone when irritated, but her face softens with devotion toward her favorite charges.

_Sources: [v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000), [v4 c5 P5](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0005), [v4 c5 P11](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0011)_

## Personality

Tabitha is an intensely loyal, stern, and pragmatic woman with a strong sense of propriety and duty. She is a dedicated housekeeper who takes immense pride in her culinary skills and orderly domestic management, often expressing sharp disdain for poor homemaking. Despite her severe demeanor and strict views, she harbors deep, fierce affection for those under her care, particularly Harcourt, whom she dotes on protectively.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089), [v3 c10 P16](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0016), [v3 c10 P44](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0044), [v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000), [v4 c5 P5](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0005), [v4 c5 P6](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0006), [v4 c6 P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)_

## Traits

- Pragmatic and opinionated  <sub>[v3 c10 P16](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0016), [v4 c5 P11](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Fiercely protective and affectionate toward children  <sub>[v4 c5 P5](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0005), [v4 c5 P6](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0006)</sub>
- Strict and proper  <sub>[v3 c10 P16](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0016), [v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000)</sub>
- Proud of her domestic skills  <sub>[v4 c6 P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019), [v4 c6 P20](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0020)</sub>
- Fear of black spiders  <sub>[v5 c1 P15](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0015)</sub>

## Abilities

- Exceptional cooking and baking skills  <sub>[v4 c6 P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019), [v4 c6 P20](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0020)</sub>
- Thorough domestic cleaning and management  <sub>[v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089), [v3 c10 P16](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0016)</sub>
- Knitting and sewing  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To faithfully serve the Carrow family and manage their household efficiently  <sub>[v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000), [v4 c6 P1](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0001)</sub>

## History

Tabitha initially served as the general servant for old Miss Lavinia Pembroke at Port Marlow. Following Miss Pembroke's death, she eventually entered the service of Hugh and Nell Carrow at Hollowmere in Seven Gulls Harbor. She quickly established herself as the unyielding ruler of the kitchen, taking complete charge of the household cooking and baking. When Nell fell dangerously ill after giving birth to her youngest child, Harcourt, Tabitha nursed the fragile infant with maternal devotion, claiming a special bond with him over his own mother. She continued to manage the household with an iron hand, managing the Carrow children, scolding their flaws, and fiercely protecting them from others.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089), [v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000), [v4 c5 P5](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0005), [v4 c5 P6](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0006), [v4 c6 P1](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0001)_
